  "pros": [
    "Effective for tracking sales activities and team performance.",

    "Good reporting features for L&D insights."

  "cons": [
    "Occasional minor bugs or performance issues.",
    "Limited advanced customization options for complex L&D reporting.",
    "Customer support response times could be improved."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Learning and Development Supervisor found Freshsales to be a reliable tool for their primary task of tracking sales activities over two years. The familiarity with the Freshworks ecosystem, having used Freshchat previously, contributed to a smooth adoption. While generally positive about its core functionality and ease of use, they experienced some frustrations with occasional technical hiccups and desired more robust reporting customization."
